title.en: Community plugins for the DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Session status notifications: push workspace session changes to WeCom group robots.
description.zh: 会话状态通知：把工作区会话变化推送到企业微信群机器人。

description.en: Push workspace session status changes (started, finished, errored, waiting for your input) to notification providers. Ships a WeCom group-robot webhook provider; instances are managed from the Settings panel.
description.zh: 把工作区会话状态变化（开始运行、运行完成、运行出错、等待你确认/输入）实时推送到通知提供方。内置企业微信群机器人 Webhook 提供方，实例在设置面板中可视化增删改查。
